response: Laminoplasty outcomes do not significantly differ between patients with degenerative stenosis and those with ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament (OPLL). Both groups have similar perioperative results and neurological outcomes with laminoplasty. However, it's worth noting that laminoplasty may limit extension range of motion (ROM), and the VAS neck pain scores did not improve significantly with laminoplasty for either group.
